markdown:

Compare the actual contracting company, permissions and account terms before choosing by spread. The supplied shortlist does not establish a South African company for every brand.

Use the [FSCA provider search](https://www.fsca.co.za/FSB-Search/) to match the company and its activities. A foreign group licence, payment logo or working application is not proof of local authorisation.

## How we selected these brokers

The brief supplies these eight brands. We have not tested live accounts, execution or withdrawals, or completed current company-by-company authorisation checks. This is research rather than a tested ranking.

Separate the following questions:

- Which company signs the client agreement?
- What financial-services activities may it provide?
- Who issues or acts as counterparty to the CFD?
- What permissions apply to that role?
- Is the account domestic or international?

## South Africa CFD rules for retail traders

The supplied [FSCA OTC-provider notice](https://www.fsca.co.za/_api/cr3ad_noticedocumentses(174fb265-fed8-f011-8544-7ced8d771bb0)/cr3ad_document/$value) is a starting point for checking provider authorisation. An FSP number alone does not settle every OTC-derivative activity.

| Check | Practical question |
|---|---|
| FSP permission | Are the advice/intermediation activities covered? |
| ODP role | Is the actual derivative provider authorised for its role? |
| Customer category | Which conduct protections apply to this relationship? |
| Product terms | What margin, liquidation and liability rules apply? |

Do not import EU leverage ceilings or a universal negative-balance guarantee. Use the actual contract and current requirements. Our [position size calculator](/tools/forex-position-size-calculator) separates cash risk from margin.

## FSCA protections explained

The brief cites a [conduct document](https://www.fsca.co.za/_api/cr3ad_noticedocumentses(b24d8fc1-379f-f111-b8dc-70a8a57fc5ff)/cr3ad_document/$value), [financial-resources document](https://www.fsca.co.za/_api/cr3ad_noticedocumentses(4cab0b96-379f-f111-b8dc-70a8a57fc5ff)/cr3ad_document/$value) and [consultation material](https://www.fsca.co.za/_api/cr3ad_documentsofconsultationses(aa3dfa13-0dd2-f011-bbd3-7ced8d771a24)/cr3ad_document/$value). Their current adoption, scope and application have not been independently established here.

Ask about suitability, disclosures, customer classification, client assets and financial resources. A proposal or licence number should not be treated as a blanket guarantee.

## Investor protection: what it covers

| Arrangement | What to establish | Limitation |
|---|---|---|
| Client assets | Custodian and handling rules | Not guaranteed returns |
| Deficit protection | Whether contractually offered and exclusions | Not assumed for every account |
| Firm failure | Complaint/recovery process and any applicable scheme | No universal compensation limit established here |

Trading losses are not automatically reimbursed by a regulator. Read the actual company's protections.

## Payment methods in South Africa

Confirm ZAR/account-currency conversion, bank/card availability, minimums, fees and withdrawal conditions. A local payment option does not identify the company or settle cross-border requirements. Once the account is appropriate, consider a small test transaction and confirm receipt.

Our [platform guide](/insights/best-platforms-for-day-trading) helps assess tools before funding.

## Red flags to avoid

- A company name that does not match official records.
- Guaranteed profits or pressure to deposit.
- Payments to personal accounts.
- Withdrawal-release charges or unexplained tax demands.

## FAQs

### Is forex trading legal in South Africa?

The company, activities, product and account matter. Verify relevant FSCA permissions, including the provider's role for OTC derivatives, and any applicable funding requirements. This shortlist does not authorise every brand or transaction.

### Which forex broker is best for beginners in South Africa?

Start with verified company/product permissions, demo usability, education and total costs. IG, Plus500 and AvaTrade are research leads from the supplied brief, not a tested ranking or guaranteed resident offer.

### Is negative-balance protection the same as investor protection?

No. Contractual negative-balance protection concerns deficit liability. Other safeguards concern conduct, assets or firm failure. Neither means ordinary trading losses are insured.

## Final recommendation

Resolve the actual company, FSP/ODP roles and domestic versus international account terms first. Practise with a demo and compare full costs before applying. Never use money needed for essentials; leveraged forex and CFDs can cause rapid losses.
